name: River Hill Fall 2015

venue.name: [River Hill High School](http://www2.hcpss.org/rhhs)
venue.details: Competition is in the cafeteria of the school.

information: The registration is $15 base fee for 3x3 and an additional $1 per extra event. Registration at the door may or may not be an option. All competitors will pay at the door and please be sure to bring exact change. Spectators will be admitted for free.
